value.rationale: Example 4 of the motivating paper singles out precisely the failure of Hilbert balance for an asymmetric external linear weight without computing its parameter law. The present exact all-a/all-p classification characterizes an entire natural invariant, including every maximizing vector configuration and a strict geometric phase change at p=2 whose derivative jump is explicitly binary entropy. These structural results are not merely a renamed balanced bound or a small numerical increment.
